description: Source code for managing shallow clone information in a Git repository, including functions for reading, writing, updating, and pruning shallow commit data, as well as handling shallow commit graphs and reachability tests.

methods.name: set_alternate_shallow_file
methods.description: Sets the alternate shallow file path for the repository, with checks to prevent calling before shallow state is initialized.

methods.name: register_shallow
methods.description: Registers a shallow commit graft in the repository, replacing existing parents if commit is parsed.

methods.name: unregister_shallow
methods.description: Removes a shallow graft for a given object ID from the repository.

methods.name: is_repository_shallow
methods.description: Checks if the repository is shallow by reading the shallow file and updating internal state.

methods.name: reset_repository_shallow
methods.description: Resets the shallow state of the repository to uninitialized.

methods.name: commit_shallow_file
methods.description: Commits the current shallow file lock and updates in-memory shallow state.

methods.name: rollback_shallow_file
methods.description: Rolls back the shallow file lock and resets shallow state.

methods.name: free_depth_in_slab
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for commit depth slabs.

methods.name: get_shallow_commits
methods.description: Retrieves a list of shallow commits up to a specified depth, considering grafts and shallow state.

methods.name: show_commit
methods.description: Inserts a commit into a list for display or processing.

methods.name: get_shallow_commits_by_rev_list
methods.description: Runs rev-list to identify shallow border commits and mark reachable commits accordingly.

methods.name: check_shallow_file_for_update
methods.description: Verifies that the shallow file has not changed since last read.

methods.name: write_one_shallow
methods.description: Writes a shallow commit graft to output buffer if it meets criteria.

methods.name: write_shallow_commits_1
methods.description: Writes shallow commit grafts and extra OIDs to output buffer.

methods.name: write_shallow_commits
methods.description: Wrapper to write shallow commits with default flags.

methods.name: setup_temporary_shallow
methods.description: Creates a temporary shallow file with current shallow commits for transfer.

methods.name: setup_alternate_shallow
methods.description: Sets up an alternate shallow file with shallow commits, locking the shallow file.

methods.name: advertise_shallow_grafts
methods.description: Advertises shallow grafts over a network connection.

methods.name: prune_shallow
methods.description: Prunes shallow commits based on reachability and options, updating the shallow file.

methods.name: prepare_shallow_info
methods.description: Prepares shallow info by splitting commits into 'ours' and 'theirs' based on object existence.

methods.name: clear_shallow_info
methods.description: Frees memory associated with shallow info.

methods.name: remove_nonexistent_theirs_shallow
methods.description: Removes entries from 'theirs' that no longer exist in the object database.

methods.name: assign_shallow_commits_to_refs
methods.description: Associates shallow commits with refs, marking reachability and updating shallow maps.

methods.name: post_assign_shallow
methods.description: Performs reachability tests on 'ours' and 'theirs' shallow commits at the commit level.

methods.name: delayed_reachability_test
methods.description: Performs a delayed reachability test for a specific shallow commit.
